summary: BANKNIFTY at Quote before any REST index quote: the feed looks its streaming id (-25) up over REST as it subscribes, as the web does, and streams it (audit RB-05).

notes: The web's adapter fetches the listingId at subscribe (samco_adapter.py _get_index_listing_id, BrokerData.get_index_listing_id over /quote/indexQuote); the glue answers it with the same id. The desktop's step is Broker::feed_presubscribe (brokers/samco/presubscribe.rs).

deviations.reason: For an index the web sends a best bid and ask of 0 that Samco never sent (an index has no book; the frame has no bPr/aPr); the desktop leaves them out.

Samco sent no ltq for the index, and the web sends last_quantity 0, a value it never received; the desktop leaves it out. (Where Samco does send an ltq for an index, the desktop must send it, under both of the adapter's names: a Phase B fix.)
As last_quantity: the web sends last_trade_quantity 0 for an index frame without ltq; the desktop leaves it out.
Samco's index quote carries no vol; the web sends volume 0, a value it never received (samcoWebSocket._normalize_market_data defaults vol to 0); the desktop leaves it out.
